t: This is linked to the Arvon Foundation, a charity that promotes creative writing and runs writing courses across the United Kingdom. It is one of Arts Council England's National Portfolio Organisations. Arvon was founded in 1968 by two men. John Moat was a British poet, and John Fairfax is named alongside him as co-founder. The material I have says little more about this particular place, so that is the story of the organisation behind it.
